questions.title: Which film will win the Special Jury Prize at the 2026 Venice Film Festival?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The Venice Film Festival’s official announcement of its 2026 award winners. Resolution : Resolve to the film awarded the Special Jury Prize at the 2026 festival, once the winner is publicly announced. Accepted Answer Format : The winning film’s title.
questions.current_reasoning: The 83rd Venice Film Festival competition lineup (~21 titles) will not be announced until July 23, 2026, so uncertainty is inherently very high—each rumored contender faces both selection risk and ~5% baseline conditional odds for the Special Jury Prize under jury president Maggie Gyllenhaal. Historically, the Special Jury Prize favors bold European/Italian and international auteur cinema rather than pure Hollywood studio entries. Based on June 2026 Variety, Elle Italia, and PressBee projections, Nanni Moretti's It Will Happen Tonight, Stephane Brize's A Good Little Soldier, Werner Herzog's Bucking Fastard, Martin McDonagh's Wild Horse Nine, and Andrea Pallaoro's The Echo Chamber are among the highest-probability competition locks fitting the prize profile, leaving ~76% mass on the broader unannounced field.

Resolution Window : Resolve to the province explicitly identified by WHO as experiencing surging weekly Ebola cases in its outbreak assessment publicly reported between September 10 and September 16, 2026. Bloomberg/Straits Times (July 15) reported that isolation facilities in North Kivu are ALREADY operating at over 120% occupancy—showing that despite M23 containing southern Goma, active overflow is hitting northern North Kivu right across the highway corridor from Ituri, where an angry mob attacked Nyakunde Hospital on July 15 (forcing Samaritan's Purse to evacuate and up to 10 Ebola patients to flee) alongside pay strikes shutting Bunia General Hospital and halting Rwampara safe burials. Restoring North Kivu sharply 0.16 -> 0.22. Holding Ituri at 0.34 (>90% of current cases per WHO July 14, with containment collapsing, though two months remain until mid-September). Trimming Tshopo slightly 0.30 -> 0.27 (still major #2 urban explosion threat in 1.5M-pop Kisangani on the Congo River, though confirmed cases remain low so far) and Haut-Uele 0.12 -> 0.10 (IRC warns of cross-border spread toward South Sudan), with South Kivu at 0.02 and 5% residual for Kinshasa/Bas-Uele/Maniema.

questions.title: Which U.S. state will report the country's first measles death of 2026?
questions.background: Measles can cause fatal complications, and state health departments monitor and report deaths associated with the disease.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official state health department announcements, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting from reliable news organizations. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the state that publicly reports a measles death among its residents occurring in calendar year 2026 and identified as the first reported U.S. measles fatality of that year. Resolution occurs when that announcement is made. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the U.S. state.
questions.current_reasoning: As of June 5, 2026, the CDC reported 2,030 U.S. measles cases across 30 outbreaks with zero deaths so far (6% hospitalized, 92% unvaccinated/unknown). Although South Carolina recorded the most cumulative 2026 cases (669), its outbreak was officially declared over on April 27, shifting ongoing mortality risk to active hubs: Utah (486 cases, 54 hospitalized with severe pneumonia and encephalitis), Texas (182 cases, site of two 2025 deaths), Florida (154 cases and still adding weekly cases), neighboring Arizona (border outbreak corridor with Utah), and populous California. Because roughly 45-50 of early June's ~55 weekly cases occurred across two dozen other states, 50% of probability mass rightly remains outside the top five states.

questions.title: If the Detroit Tigers trade Tarik Skubal by the 2026 MLB trade deadline, which team will acquire him?
questions.background: Tarik Skubal is a starting pitcher for the Detroit Tigers and is eligible for free agency after the 2026 season.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official MLB or team announcements, or confirmed reporting from ESPN, identifying a completed trade of Tarik Skubal by the 2026 MLB trade deadline. Resolution : Resolve to the MLB club acquiring Skubal directly from the Detroit Tigers. If no such trade occurs by the deadline, the question is void. questions.current_reasoning: Detroit's 24-14 surge since June 1 (46-52 through July 19, 3.5 GB of the third AL wild card) makes a trade uncertain, but this market resolves strictly conditional on a trade by the Aug. 3 deadline. All-Star Week reporting (July 14-17) from ESPN's Jeff Passan and NY Post's Jon Heyman sharply reshaped the suitor hierarchy: both specifically identified the Atlanta Braves (leading NL East, eager to pair Skubal with Chris Sale), Chicago Cubs (most acute need per Passan, though thinner farm), and Tampa Bay Rays (best AL record and deep farm, despite typical aversion to costly rentals) as the primary suitors, with Passan also highlighting the Los Angeles Dodgers (best farm and unlimited cash) while Heyman called LA a 'wild card' and reported the Yankees and Dodgers are not currently strong bidders. Downgraded the Yankees (0.14 -> 0.06) and dropped the Blue Jays (unmentioned in July intel) in favor of the Rays, Braves, and Cubs while keeping 33% on the rest of the MLB contender field.

questions.title: Which club will Mohamed Salah join first after leaving Liverpool at the end of the 2025–26 season?
questions.background: Mohamed Salah has announced that he will leave Liverpool at the end of the season.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official announcement from Salah or his new club, or reliable news reporting confirming a completed signing. Resolution Condition : Resolve to the first club with which Salah signs a senior playing contract following his departure from Liverpool at the end of the 2025–26 season. Transfer speculation, negotiations, and trial appearances do not qualify. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the club.
questions.current_reasoning: Following Egypt's World Cup R16 exit, Besiktas surged to clear frontrunner (-333 betting odds on July 21) after Foot Mercato reported a verbal 1+1 year agreement and Besiktas president Serdal Adali publicly confirmed on July 20 that Salah spoke with coach Vincenzo Italiano and gave his approval. However, the deal is NOT finalized: Adali admitted negotiations are stalled and at risk of collapsing over agent Ramy Abbas Issa's reported 35% commission demand, Besiktas issued a statement dismissing leaked terms as fabricated, and Issa tweeted he does not yet know where Salah will play while noting they only negotiate with clubs Salah would want to join. Fabrizio Romano confirmed Besiktas submitted an offer alongside competing MLS and Saudi offers; bookmakers list Al-Hilal, Al-Ahli, and 'Any MLS team' next at +350 (with San Diego FC via Egyptian owner Sir Mohamed Mansour and Sporting KC leading MLS links, and Fenerbahce retaining a smaller swoop chance if Besiktas collapses). Capped Besiktas at 0.48 due to the unconfirmed status and real commission deadlock.

questions.title: Who will win the 2026 Formula One Hungarian Grand Prix?
questions.background: The Hungarian Grand Prix is a round of the Formula One World Championship.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The official race classification published by Formula One or the FIA. Resolution : Resolve to the driver classified as the winner of the Hungarian Grand Prix scheduled for July 26, 2026. This concerns the Grand Prix itself, not any sprint race. Accepted Answer Format : The winning driver's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: 2026-07-19 post-Belgian GP update (Formula1.com, Reuters, BBC Sport): Kimi Antonelli won Spa from pole (6th win and 6th pole in 10 rounds, opening a 45-pt lead), cleanly repassing Charles Leclerc on track, nudging Antonelli 0.31 -> 0.33 (capped by Toto Wolff's admission that both Mercedes cars suffered Turn-1 boost losses and reliability remains their clearest weakness). Charles Leclerc surges 0.15 -> 0.18 into #2 after following his Silverstone victory with P2 at power-heavy Spa just 1.952s behind Antonelli; Ferrari's race pace should translate even better to high-downforce Hungaroring. Eight-time Hungary winner Lewis Hamilton holds at 0.16 after finishing P4 despite lap-1 damage, a 5s penalty, and a botched pitstop (cleared of driver fault/Hungary grid penalty; Ferrari fined €30k). George Russell drops 0.14 -> 0.12 after a separate Turn-1 battery/boost loss led to a lap-1 DNF on top of his still-unsolved 0.2-0.6s straight-line deficit with only 5 days before Hungary (mitigated slightly by Hungaroring's corner-heavy layout where Russell matched Antonelli). Max Verstappen enters at 0.08 (displacing Lando Norris 0.09 -> ~0.07 outside top 5) after taking P3 at Spa alongside Isack Hadjar's P20-to-P6 charge, while McLaren TP Andrea Stella explicitly warned on July 19 that Spa flattered McLaren and they must improve braking and cornering to challenge rivals at Hungary and Zandvoort. Top-5 sum = 0.87 (Mercedes 0.45, Ferrari 0.34, Verstappen 0.08), leaving 0.13 for Norris (~0.07), Oscar Piastri (~0.045), Hadjar (~0.01), and chaos (~0.005).
